title: Proof audit exercise
source:
Claim C001.
Fix an integer m >= 1. For each n, let X_{n,1},...,X_{n,m} be real random variables.
For every j in {1,...,m}, assume X_{n,j} -> 0 in probability as n -> infinity.
Then max_{1<=j<=m}|X_{n,j}| -> 0 in probability.
Proof. Fix epsilon > 0.
The union bound gives P(max_{j<=m}|X_{n,j}| > epsilon) <= sum_{j=1}^m P(|X_{n,j}| > epsilon).
Each summand tends to zero. Since m is fixed, the finite sum tends to zero, proving the claim.
